feedback.problem:
Find $By$ if 
$B=[\begin{aligned}a & -a & a \\ a & -2b & b \\ 2a & -b & a\end{aligned}]$
and
$y=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}By & =[\begin{aligned}a & -a & a \\ a & -2b & b \\ 2a & -b & a\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ -1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}a\cdot 1+(-a)\cdot (-1)+a\cdot (-1) \\ a\cdot 1+(-2b)\cdot (-1)+b\cdot (-1) \\ 2a\cdot 1+(-b)\cdot (-1)+a\cdot (-1)\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}a+a-a \\ a+2b-b \\ 2a+b-a\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}a \\ a+b \\ a+b\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
